title: Simulation on a padded tape bank
statement: Let $k\le K$, let $S,H$ be types, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine with states in $S$, let $N$ be a $K$-tape machine with states in $H$, and let $	ext{emb}:S\to H$. Suppose that for every source state, input symbol, and $K$-tuple of scanned work-tape symbols, $N$'s transition at the embedded state equals the padded action obtained from $M$'s transition using the first $k$ scanned symbols. Then for every source configuration $c$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running $N$ for $t$ steps from the padded configuration of $c$ gives the padding of the configuration reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers k and K with k ≤ K
source machine M with k tapes and states in S
host machine N with K tapes and states in H
map emb from S to H
transition agreement for every state, input symbol, and K-tuple of scanned symbols
